newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: INTERVIEW-Wattyl looks to 97/98 profit jump.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW-Wattyl looks to 97/98 profit jump.

text.p: Paint manufacturer Wattyl Ltd managing director Greg Boshell said on Wednesday a profit increase in the year to June 30, 1998 was achievable, despite a subdued outlook for its main market Australia.
"We are looking for a profit increase and we think that is achievable," Boshell told Reuters in a telephone interview.

Wattyl earlier reported a net profit of A$25.81 million for the year to June 30, 1997, compared with A$20.31 million a year ago. Year sales rose 7.6 percent to A$494.04 million, but the company kept its final dividend steady at 11 cents per share.
